For me, I am kinda thinking it is less "helmet" in the traditional sense, and more like very large ski goggles.  This would nicely explain the Train Gaurd resting not only on his face/head but also on his chest. 

Edit: Actually, we can see exactly how his Helmet functions based off the art found in his Bio. The Helmet is attached to two tracks that are strapped around his shoulders and back. You can see gears on either side of the Train Guard that act as the locking/movement mechanism. It seems like Fright Train can move his helmet into an up position, protecting his face, or in a down position, probably affording him better vision and less strain (if any at all) on his shoulders. It is totally more of a "mask" than it is a "helmet", as it does not encase Fright Trains entire head, just his face. The back of his head is left exposed with the Train Guard in the "up" position.

Personally, I think his physical structure was altered in a way that he can bend his head down without great effort, maybe rotating his shoulders around to lower his head.
